title: Wi-Fi drops: cause
text: Our devices connect on the 2.4 GHz band. Mesh routers that use band steering can push a device onto the wrong band, which causes repeated disconnects and failed setup at the Wi-Fi step.

title: Wi-Fi drops: troubleshooting steps
text: Step 1: in the router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable band steering. Step 2: hold the device's reset button for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. Step 3: set the device up again in the app on the 2.4 GHz network.

title: Wi-Fi drops: escalation
text: If the device still drops after 24 hours, ask the customer for their router model and escalate to the network team.

title: Duplicate or unexpected charges: authorization and capture
text: When a payment is authorized and then captured, some banks show both as separate pending lines for 2 to 3 business days before the authorization drops off. The customer is only ever charged once per order.

title: Duplicate or unexpected charges: what to ask for
text: If both charges are still showing after 3 business days, ask the customer for the last four digits of the card and the order number.

title: Duplicate or unexpected charges: refunds
text: A confirmed duplicate charge is refunded within one business day of receiving the last four digits of the card and the order number. Charges the customer does not recognize are checked against the order history first.

title: Damaged on arrival: replacement
text: A device that arrives damaged is replaced at no cost. Ask the customer for a photo of the damage and a photo of the shipping label so a carrier claim can be filed from our side.

title: Damaged on arrival: shipping the replacement
text: Once the photos are received, ship a replacement with a prepaid return label for the damaged unit. The customer does not need to wait for the return to arrive before the replacement ships.

title: Damaged on arrival: turnaround
text: The typical turnaround for a damaged-on-arrival replacement is 3 business days.

title: App: devices missing or offline
text: A sync issue in the current app release can hide a device from the device list or show it as offline even though it works. The fix is in app version 4.13.0, which is rolling out now.

title: App: workaround until the update
text: Until the update: sign out of the app, force close it, sign back in, and pull down on the device list to refresh. This re-syncs the device for most people.

title: App: still missing after the update
text: If the device is still missing after updating to 4.13.0, ask for the email on the customer's account and re-link the device from the support side.

title: Returns: window
text: Any device can be returned within 45 days of delivery, opened or unopened, for a full refund. This includes devices that have already been set up.

title: Returns: how to start
text: To start a return, the customer opens Orders in their account, picks the order, and chooses Start a return. A prepaid label is issued to print or show at any drop-off point.

title: Returns: refunds and setup
text: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return being scanned in. If the device was set up, the customer should remove it from the app first so the next owner can pair it.

title: Warranty: coverage
text: Every device carries a 3-year limited warranty counted from the delivery date, covering devices that stop working or become unreliable.

title: Warranty: starting a claim
text: To start a warranty claim, ask the customer for the order number or the serial number on the base of the unit, plus a short description of the symptoms.

title: Warranty: replacement
text: An approved claim gets a replacement device with a prepaid label for the faulty one. The customer can keep using the original until the replacement arrives, if it still works.

title: Automations and schedules
text: Schedules and automations are set up in the app without any third-party tools: open the device, tap Automations, then Add.

title: Automation triggers
text: A trigger can be a time, sunrise or sunset, or an event from another device such as the doorbell. Then choose what the device should do. Automations run on the device itself, so they keep working when the customer's phone is away.

title: Voice assistants
text: For voice control, enable the Nook Home skill in Alexa or the Nook Home action in Google Home. The device appears automatically after the customer links their account.

title: Shipping times
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the continental US. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed after 2 pm ship the next business day.

title: Doorbell video clips
text: Video clips from the Sentry doorbell are stored in the cloud for 30 days and then deleted automatically. Clips can be downloaded from the app before they expire.

title: Battery life
text: The Sentry doorbell battery lasts up to 6 months on a full charge, depending on how many motion events it records. A low-battery alert appears in the app at 15 percent.

title: Cancelling an order
text: An order can be cancelled for a full refund within 24 hours of purchase, as long as it has not shipped. After that, use the returns process.

title: Firmware updates
text: Firmware updates install automatically overnight and take about 10 minutes. The device restarts once and keeps all of its settings and automations.

title: Support hours
text: Support is available from 8 am to 8 pm Eastern, Monday to Saturday. Messages sent outside those hours are answered the next business day.

title: Professional installation
text: Professional installation appointments for the thermostat and the doorbell take up to 2 hours and can be booked from the Orders page for 3 weeks after delivery.

title: Account data
text: Account data is stored in the United States. Customers can export or delete their data from the account page, and deletion completes within 7 days.
